correctness.rationale: Exact angular reduction to one 1D and countably many 2D blocks; beta-moment/Jacobi coefficients give [X,Y]=a1*a2² times the skew matrix. Taylor C^3 remainders have block norm O(m^-3), cross-commutators O(m^-4); the two singular values per mode have leading coefficient (alpha+2)*sqrt(alpha+1)*abs(W)*m^-3, producing the ordered constant eight times that coefficient. Exact-rational checker supports recurrence identity but is not substituted for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The first noncommutative radial Bergman case acquires a universal and sharp quantitative boundary two-jet obstruction. The formula classifies a whole C^3 symbol-pair family across all alpha>-1, supplies the exact p=1/3 Schatten threshold and an improved rate under jet cancellation, refining a qualitative algebra picture rather than recomputing a known scalar table.
